description: This file defines a Java interface 'ProductReviewDao' for accessing product review data in the database, with methods to retrieve reviews by customer, product, language, and specific product-customer pairs.

classes.name: ProductReviewDao
classes.description: A DAO interface for performing database operations related to product reviews.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Fetches a list of product reviews submitted by the specified customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews associated with the specified product.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for the specified product in the specified language.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Fetches a specific review for a given product and customer pair identified by their IDs.
